prompt:
Edit this workbook in place:
`Shared/Finance/Close/2026/06 June/4 WIP/WIP risk cases_7.1 847am - NB REVIEW COPY.xlsx`

Begin with the controller's WIP-close request in `Requests/`. Locate and reconcile the current system balances, PM forecast, commercial log, project support packets, and signed WIP policy. Populate the blue source-input cells on `Risk Review` for all four projects; then fill rows 6:9 with formulas for Close ETC, EAC, % complete, Earned Revenue, Contract Asset, Contract Liability, Total Estimated Margin at Completion (current contract less EAC), and Margin %. Fill the `TOTAL / CONTROL` row with formulas for every applicable dollar column.

Preserve the project identities, evidence-role map, sheet names, workbook style, and existing notes. Do not add pending revenue or paste a downstream summary over the source cells. Recalculate the workbook with LibreOffice or Excel and save it to the same path. Your final response can simply confirm completion; the workbook is graded.
